name: Renan Leroy
source:
Renan is short-tempered and easy to anger. He uses sarcasm as his love language, and even though he puts up a hard-to-get front, he is filled with insecurities.

His family is rich... Like, insanely rich and his relatives expect his absolute obedience to them without question.

Magic: Water Elemental
Occupation: Student
Species: Human
